description: A route segment wrapper component that composes from root to leaf and preserves React state and DOM nodes across sibling navigations.
A segment wrapper placed inside layout.tsx that creates a fresh component instance and re-runs effects on every route navigation.
The App Router optimization where shared parent layouts remain mounted while only the changing child route segments re-render.
The top-level app/layout.tsx component that wraps every route and defines the mandatory HTML and body document tags.
